meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude能帮你查询Azure订阅里各类资源的配额限制、当前用量和剩余可用量；还能比较不同区域的配额，并提交提高配额的申请。
howto.when: 当你说“check quotas”、“service limits”等关键词，或要求提高配额时触发。

say.text: 查一下我的订阅在 eastus 的 vCPU 配额和当前用量。
say.note: Claude会运行CLI，返回限制、用量和可用容量。

say.text: 帮我把 standardDSv3Family 的配额提高到 500。
say.note: Claude会提交配额增加请求并返回状态。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can query Azure quota limits, current usage, and available capacity. It can compare quotas across regions and request quota increases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'check quotas', 'service limits', etc., or ask to increase quotas.

say_en.text: Check my vCPU quota and current usage in eastus.
say_en.note: Claude returns limit, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare standardDSv3Family quota between eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Claude queries each region and shows a comparison.

say_en.text: Request a quota increase for standardDSv3Family to 500.
say_en.note: Claude submits the increase request and returns status.
